camping: Käsivarsi temporary camping rules apply on the Finnish side before the border.
Norwegian-side travel must be considerate of nature, cultural values, wildlife, domestic reindeer, livestock and other users in Ráisduottarháldi.
Field reports describe good tenting around Somashytta, but no current mapped official tent-area coordinate was found.
shelters: Kopmajoki open wilderness hut at start.
Somashytta open/simple Norwegian border hut at end.
fire: Käsivarsi side: fire rules follow Finnish wilderness-reserve and wildfire-warning rules.
Norway side: general bonfire ban applies 15 April-15 September, with exceptions only where fire clearly cannot cause wildfire; check current fire danger and local bans.
Reisa guidance favors established sites or fallen/pre-positioned wood and forbids cutting trees.
Somashytta field reports indicate firewood may be unreliable; do not imply guaranteed heat.
toilets: Somashytta dry toilet/outhouse verified from management-plan text and OSM coordinate.
waste: No importable Somashytta waste point found; pack out waste and clean after use.

dogsAndBorder: Dogs must be leashed in Käsivarsi.
Norway/Reisa/Nordreisa normal leash period is 1 April-20 August.

Border-crossing dog rules require ID marking, rabies vaccination and pet passport; anti-echinococcus treatment is generally required for EU/EEA-to-Norway travel but not for dogs travelling directly from Finland to Norway. Recheck Mattilsynet before publication.
fireAndFuel: Norway general bonfire ban runs 15 April-15 September; use current local fire-danger guidance.
Do not imply Somashytta has reliable gas or firewood; recent reports conflict with generic Reisa wording.
Kopmajoki and Somashytta firewood/stoves should be hut-amenity notes, not outdoor fire POIs.
seasonalAndWeather: No active Somashytta/Kopmajoki closure or reroute found in checked official sources.
Statskog published 2026 ice/snow reports for Troms/Nordland on 2026-01-30; use as winter-currentness source only.
Varsom publishes daily Nord-Troms avalanche forecasts in season; check live before winter/spring travel.
2025 stomach-flu notice affected Kalottireitti generally but not this section specifically; 2025-07-08 notice said Kalottireitti was open for normal hiking again.
waterAndCrossings: Natural water should be purified; no maintained drinking-water point verified.
Section-specific crossing evidence is strong enough for a safety note but not yet normalized as importable crossing facilities.
Water levels vary with rain and snowmelt; wading shoes may be needed.
reindeerHerdingHuntingFishing: Both Käsivarsi and Reisa/Ráisduottarháldi are reindeer-use areas; avoid disturbing reindeer and herding operations.
Reisa notes more than 20,000 reindeer graze or migrate through the area; take special care during calving and breeding periods.
Finnish Käsivarsi hunting/fishing rules apply before the border; Norwegian Reisa rules allow hunting/fishing in season with licence. Do not import these as hiking restrictions.
markingAndBorder: Finnish side uses low posts/boards; Norwegian side uses cairns/red T marks.
Field reports note border cairn 305A soon after Somashytta and a reindeer fence with steps/gate.
Keep border/marking transition as route metadata.

agents.summary: Confirmed Reisa 3 km leg, Kopmajoki Luontoon sources, Somashytta UT/Kartverket/Reisa evidence, Reisa management-plan capacity/toilet details, and marking-management context.

Measured OSM relation 9518105 at 3.256 km, E1 GPX at 3.236 km, and Luontoon partial line at 2.217 km to the transition point; identified route endpoint/POI coordinate caveats, gate, fords and marking transition.

Verified Kopmajoki hut/toilet/waste and Somashytta hut/toilet; flagged DNT/UT booking suppression, Somashytta coordinate conflict, water/fire/camping pending notes and no official bridge/fireplace POI.

Confirmed endpoints are wilderness-only, Kilpisjärvi is the Finnish access gateway, Guolasjávri/Halti is a seasonal road alternative, Saraelv/Ovi is north-side approach, and snowmobile options are private/seasonal logistics.

Collected 2012-2025 reports for 3-4 km distances, easy dry-route conditions, border cairn 305A, reindeer fence/gate, repeated channels/crossings, Somashytta coordinate and fuel/heat caveats, and wind/exposure risk.

Covered Käsivarsi and Ráisduottarháldi rules, Reisa onward context, Norway fire/dog/pet-border rules, reindeer, hunting/fishing, winter/avalanche/currentness, stomach-flu history and crossing hazards.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Research is complete enough for candidate-file normalization review. Do not mark automated-import-ready until Somashytta coordinate/operator semantics, full geometry source policy, ford/crossing coordinates, and Norway-side rules/access wording are normalized.

Normalize the Finland-Norway border/marking transition point, reindeer fence/gate, and ford/crossing coordinates.
Resolve Somashytta operator/type taxonomy: Reisa/Statskog-managed open hut versus DNT-derived secondary records.
Verify current Somashytta toilet, tenting/fireplace and firewood status before import wording.
Before publishing access notes, verify Guolasjávri road status, Svipper/Matkahuolto schedules, and any winter snowmobile route statuses from live sources.
